integrity: The proof uses exact algebraic identities and an exact resultant. Numerical plots and decimal orbit data from the source are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Only centrally symmetric real period-two cycles on the odd-numbered invariant critical lines are classified; higher-period, nonsymmetric, and nonreal cycles remain outside the claim, and the even-degree convergence question remains open.
title: Two repelling symmetry-forced 2-cycles for even Chebyshev maps
